explication: Context Hub is a curated, versioned documentation and agent-skill browser distributed as a CLI and MCP server. The main workflow is to search the registry, resolve a selected document’s language/version and reference files, fetch content, and return or save it; agents can add persistent local annotations and send feedback. The graph also includes content-index construction and optional telemetry. Relationships are limited to the README and supplied source excerpts/index; unsampled command internals are represented only where documented.
